documents.title: JUBLCPL: Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Unsecured Creditors To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Equity Shareholders To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,852 million for Q4 FY26, representing a 22% year-on-year growth. Revenue growth in the adhesives business was supported by GST rate reductions and a recovery in discretionary spending, while industrial and food polymers faced demand softness due to global weakness. The company plans to commence operations at its new polymer adhesive facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27. Additionally, input costs for key materials like sulphur and acid faced inflationary pressures due to geopolitical disruptions. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million for Q3 FY26, representing a 13% year-on-year growth, alongside EBITDA growth of 15% to INR 393 million.
